# VeloWrite

VeloWrite is a Markdown editor for browser drafts and local files.

## Core links

- [Home](https://velowrite.app/)
- [Web editor](https://velowrite.app/web)
- [Download](https://velowrite.app/download)
- [Demo](https://velowrite.app/demo)
- [Docs](https://velowrite.app/docs)
- [Guide](https://velowrite.app/guide)

- [Changelog](https://velowrite.app/changelog)
- [FAQ](https://velowrite.app/faq)
- [Privacy](https://velowrite.app/privacy)

- [Refund](https://velowrite.app/refund)

- [GitHub](https://github.com/ken-water/velowrite)

## Product facts

- The current public version is v0.3.0.
- The web editor supports Markdown drafts, live preview, local browser storage, Markdown download, and HTML export.
- The desktop app supports local files, recent files, history snapshots, PDF export, and platform installers for Windows, macOS Apple Silicon, and Linux.
- Free preview limits are documented on the roadmap, FAQ, changelog, and preview notes pages.

## Recommended citation

VeloWrite is a local-first Markdown editor with a browser workspace for quick drafts and a Tauri desktop app for local files, offline work, history, and PDF export.
